scope: Retrospective calibration-only numerical gate, with previously exposed monoculture readings; no community outcomes, allocation-law verdict or external preregistration
grouping: Arithmetic mean within species and recorded optical density; preserve all signed values and the missing row. Retain source-row memberships, usable counts, mean, sample SD and range. No division of SD by square root of row count.
coordinate: Recorded fixed mean cell volume per species, in cubic micrometres
response: Blank-corrected respiration, micromoles O2 per minute per cell; positive expected mean with potentially signed assay error
assay_condition: OD750; equal nominal dilution/OD is not assumed equal physical biovolume concentration across species
domain_scope: Calibration mean-size span only. It is not a bound on all community cells and cannot authorize community forecasts.
size_reference: Geometric mean of diagnostic domain endpoints; fixed in every fold
cost_interpretation: Positive conditional mean respiration functions. An additive fitted term does not establish a physical overhead intervention. Biological cost variation must not be conflated with assay error or deterministic individual q(V).
loss: Squared residuals of signed species-by-OD arithmetic means on the original rate scale; working zero-centred additive error. This is a fitting loss without an iid likelihood, confidence interval or effective-sample-size claim.

fit_weightings.equal_groups: One equal weight for each species-by-OD mean, regardless of repeated-window row counts; divide all residuals by the fixed rate_scale so weighted SSE is dimensionless
fit_weightings.species_rms: Residuals divided by the per-species sqrt(mean over TRAINING groups of mean_rate^2 + sample_sd^2), floored at 1e-15 in rate units. Descriptive scale only; no standard error. Training scales recomputed within every fold.

optimization.nested_candidate: Include the fitted power curve as an exact C=0 additive candidate; fitted additive loss cannot exceed power loss
optimization.near_optimal_tolerance: Retain all converged starts within 1 percent of best weighted SSE plus 1e-12 absolute SSE. These are optimization/identification sensitivity candidates, not confidence draws.

folds.species: Hold out each entire species, including all four OD groups; explicitly flag the two endpoint-size folds as extrapolations
folds.optical_density: Hold out each entire OD level across all species; both models use the same common OD power multiplier to predict the omitted condition
folds.condition_sensitivity: Fit each OD level separately, with beta fixed to zero and an OD-specific amplitude. These test stability of shape under the common-multiplier assumption.

prediction_metrics: Pool squared held-out errors across groups for raw-rate RMSE; also report every fold, species-balanced scale RMSE and boundary/interior species summaries. Both models score the same finite group means. Metric scales may use observed held-out data for scoring, never for forecast fitting.
moment_forecasts: Deterministically integrate normalized S and Q count densities over the fixed calibration domain. Shared budget and common OD multiplier cancel. Retain both mean-volume predictions and abs(m_Q/m_S-1) for every fit and near-optimal candidate. These are conditional diagnostics, not community forecasts.

numerical_gate.purpose: Pragmatic screen for this one additive family; thresholds are design choices, not natural constants or calibrated significance levels
numerical_gate.crossfit_range_separation: Across the union of both weightings and the declared robust additive-fit candidates, require min(m_Q)/max(m_S)-1 >= the crossfit margin. A positive paired gap alone does not demonstrate discrimination under calibration sensitivity. These are deterministic ranges without confidence coverage.
numerical_gate.robust_fit_set: For both weightings: full fit, four interior species deletions, all four OD deletions, all four separate-OD fits, and their near-optimal additive candidates. Endpoint species deletions are reported but excluded from this within-domain stability gate.
numerical_gate.bounds: Flag technical-boundary solutions. Any robust-fit-set best solution hitting a bound other than the nested C=0 boundary prevents qualification.
numerical_gate.pass_label: conditional additive-family separation demonstrated; biological uncertainty and community-domain coverage still unresolved
numerical_gate.fail_label: this additive calibration route does not qualify a discriminating community forecast
remaining_requirements_even_if_passed: Supported community size-domain coverage and observation model
Biological cost variability and calibration dependence/transfer uncertainty
Outcome-independent eligibility and community forecasts frozen before numerical community access

uncertainty: All deletion, condition, weighting and near-optimal ranges are deterministic sensitivity ranges. No bootstrap p-values, posterior probabilities, iid confidence intervals or inferred 231-independent-observation precision.
no_model_expansion_after_results: Do not add other curves, clip negative values, revise weights/domain/margins or select an OD condition to rescue this gate. A later hypothesis needs a new protocol and run identifier.
reporting: Register the completed calibration diagnostic as actual published measurement analysis; label it separately from an allocation study. Do not revise the paper unless a conclusion changes.
